local_generator: v_c = x_c / sqrt(mean(x_c**2)+FP32eps); M_c = bias_c + scale * einsum(v_c,W_c)
orientation: x row-vector @ M; matrix axes[input stream,output stream]
init: W normal std0.5, bias identity, scale0.01; H_pre/H_post and backbone/RNG matched to old mHC
routing: original NVIDIA global H_pre/H_post and final collapse; no Sinkhorn, softmax, clipping or matrix constraints
kernel: fused local RMS/generation/mixing/branch-write; hand-derived backward; no coefficient bank saved or materialized; deterministic partial reduction

gate.logging: local, no credentials or returned weights

monitoring: 300-second checks; finish goal and stop monitoring at first finite formal training step
limitations: Only vanilla integration initially; NVIDIA fused grad buffer deliberately unsupported. FP32 routing/reductions,BF16 activations, no full dynamic cross-channel matrix.
